name: MUBAR Store - Order Processing, Courier Dispatch & Founder Alert

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "service_type_id": 1,
  "pickup_address_id": {{$env.TRAX_PICKUP_ADDRESS_ID}},
  "information_display": 1,
  "consignee_name": "{{$json.customerName}}",
  "consignee_email": "customer@mubarstore.com",
  "consignee_phone_number_1": "{{$json.phone}}",
  "consignee_address": "{{$json.address}}, {{$json.city}}",
  "consignee_city_id_or_name": "{{$json.city}}",
  "item_product_type_id": 1,
  "item_description": "{{$json.productTitle}} ({{$json.variant}}) - MUBAR Store (Open Parcel Permitted)",
  "item_quantity": {{$json.quantity}},
  "item_insurance": 0,
  "pieces_quantity": 1,
  "estimated_weight": 0.4,
  "shipping_mode_id": 1,
  "amount": {{$json.codAmountToCollect}},
  "payment_mode_id": {{$json.paymentType === 'cod' ? 1 : 2}},
  "special_instructions": "OPEN PARCEL CHECK PERMITTED: Allow customer to open the outer box and inspect watch before taking payment. 100% Guaranteed."
}
